title: MrJ-LayoutFX — board type catalogue
description: Static catalogue of board hardware types served by /api/board-types. Each key is a board type identifier used in config.json boards[].type.

capability.description: What the pin can be used for.

pinDef.description: One entry in the board's physical pin layout.

wiring.description: Logical address: GPIO number for MCU boards, 1-based output channel for SPI boards. Absent for non-connectable pins (GND, power rails, etc.).

label.description: Short text shown on the pin in the UI (e.g. 'IO23', 'Q1', 'GND').

side.description: Physical side of the board where this pin header is located.

col.description: Column index for multi-column boards (e.g. ESP32Mini). Defaults to 1 when absent.

row.description: Row position within the side/column, top-to-bottom.

capabilities.description: Capability tags that control how the UI handles the pin.

connectorPin.description: A named GPIO in a pre-cabled connector header.

connectorDef.description: A dedicated connector header that pre-cables one bus (I²C, UART, etc.).

busType.description: Bus type this connector is wired to.

linkedBusDef.description: A bus that this board pre-wires and can suggest to the user. Extends a bus definition with a unique key and a display label.

key.description: Identifier used as the bus key in config.json buses{}.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the bus suggestion UI.

boardTypeDef.description: Hardware description of one board type.

label.description: Short display name shown once a board of this type is placed (card header, pinout diagram).

dropdownLabel.description: Display name shown in the board-type picker only. Falls back to `label` when absent. Lets a one-time selection dropdown carry more context (author credit, MCU detail) than the short `label` repeated across every other view.

description.description: Longer description shown as a tooltip.

rows.description: Number of pin rows on each side. 0 for boards with no physical pin representation (UART-only, I²C-only).

oneOf.description: Bus type this board connects to. Present for expansion boards; absent (null) for the root MCU board.

usb.description: Which end of the board the USB connector is on. Used to orient the board diagram.

connectors.description: Dedicated connector headers on this board (pre-cabled buses).

pins.description: All pin positions: GPIO pins, power rails, GND, etc.

linkedBuses.description: Buses this board's MCU pre-wires. The UI offers to add them to the config when the board is selected.
